stem:
Lalit wants to see a candle flame through three holes punched in three cardboard sheets.

In which case can he see the flame?

options.text: The three holes are in a straight line with Lalit's eye.
The three holes are in a straight line, but the middle hole is higher than the other two.
The light bends between the sheets to reach Lalit's eye.
The candle is made brighter, so he can see through any arrangement of the holes.

teacher.key_rationale: Light travels in straight lines, so the holes and eye must share one line. A raised middle hole breaks alignment. Curved travel is out of scope here. Brightness does not remove the alignment need.
